title: Congenital heart diseases and parental occupational exposure in a Hungarian case-control study in 1997 to 2002.
authors: Fazekas-Pongor V, Csáky-Szunyogh M, Fekete M, Mészáros Á, Cseh K, Pénzes M.
quote: We found a positive association between paternal pesticide (adjusted odds ratio = 1.66, 95% confidence interval: 1.03-2.69) and alkylphenolic compound exposure (adjusted odds ratio = 1.95, 95% confidence interval: 1.30-2.93) and the development of patent ductus arteriosus in the offspring.
